name: Rakathon 2026 (Praha)
description: National AI hackathon against cancer where multidisciplinary teams build prototypes on real oncology challenges at Prague hospitals FN Motol and Homolka.

name: Rakathon 2026 (Brno)
description: Sister node of the national AI-against-cancer hackathon, run simultaneously at Brno's Masaryk Memorial Cancer Institute alongside the Prague and Ostrava sites.

name: ETHPrague
description: Three-day Ethereum conference and hackathon at Prague's Municipal House covering protocol development, privacy, DeFi and long-term societal impact tracks.

name: European Defense Tech Hackathon - Prague
description: Dual-use and defence-tech hackathon bringing 100+ European hackers together with military, investor and public-sector mentors for a weekend of building and a Sunday field demo day.

name: Hack Your Way
description: Brno business conference pairing keynotes and workshops with a full-day intensive hackathon on AI, vibe coding and automation for founders and marketers.

name: Hackathon verejne spravy
description: Nationwide public-administration hackathon where regional student teams refine or build new open-data applications, judged at the Supreme Audit Office in Prague.

name: Medialni Hackathon (VOSP)
description: 50-hour multimedia journalism hackathon where student teams at the Higher Professional School of Journalism build a themed multimedia website under time pressure.

name: Stavebni Hackathon
description: Construction-innovation hackathon held during Brno's Architecture Festival and Building Fair, where Czech and Slovak university teams design affordable, sustainable housing using BIM and modular methods.

name: Hackathon ML/AI 2026
description: Weekend hackathon for high-school students applying machine learning and neural networks to technical problems, hosted by the Software Engineering Department of FJFI CVUT.

name: Hack Kosice
description: Slovakia's largest and only MLH-affiliated international student hackathon: 24 hours of building software for challenges set by tech companies and university partners.
prizes: UPJS Challenge main prize; Tatrabanka, Investtech, JetBrains and MLH partner prizes

name: Climathon Bratislava
description: 48-hour climate-action hackathon where student teams and tech enthusiasts work with Bratislava city officials and mentors on urban sustainability and mobility challenges.
organizer_name: City of Bratislava / Civitta / Innovation League

name: Erste Digital Hackathon (Kosice)
description: 24-hour corporate hackathon where TUKE student teams build AI and fintech prototypes for Erste Digital / Slovenska sporitelna banking challenges.

name: ETHBratislava Hackathon
description: Central Europe's Ethereum conference and hackathon at STU's Faculty of Informatics, covering scalability, restaking and euro-backed stablecoin tracks.

name: AIM Healthcare Hackathon Vienna
description: In-person hackathon where clinicians and engineers build working healthcare prototypes together across diagnostic-AI and clinical-adoption tracks, plus a remote community track.

name: Cultural Hackathon Austria (GLAMhack)
description: 2.5-day open-cultural-data hackathon where developers, historians and museum staff prototype projects using digital heritage-fund data under the theme 'Leave No One Behind'.
venue_name: FH St. Poelten, Campus 1, Future Lab
prizes: Implementation support from partners and sponsors

name: START Hack Vienna
description: 24-hour hackathon at Vienna's Home of Innovation where teams tackle four real challenges from partner companies across voice AI, automation, legal tech and robotics.

name: Digital Girls Hackathon
description: TU Wien / City of Vienna program where girls aged 11-13 learn Scratch programming and build creative visions for the future of Vienna in small teams.
organizer_name: Urban Innovation Vienna / TU Wien Informatics

name: Bundeslehrlingshackathon
description: Austria-wide apprentice hackathon where nearly 60 finalist teams from all nine states build app prototypes, judged across Rookie, Professional and Expert categories.
prizes: Awards across Rookies, Professionals, Experts categories

name: Hacktivity
description: Central and Eastern Europe's premier IT security festival, combining talks, workshops and a hacking/CTF competition (HackCenter) for the cybersecurity community.

name: JunctionX Budapest
description: Hungary's largest hybrid hackathon: a 48-hour event where developers, designers and entrepreneurs solve company-set challenges online and on-site in Budapest.

name: Data-Eng Hackathon (Pannon Egyetem)
description: Multi-round data-engineering hackathon where student teams tackle real technology and engineering challenges from home before presenting at an in-person finale in Veszprem.
venue_name: University of Pannonia, Faculty of Technical Informatics
prizes: Academic credits plus sponsor prizes (Aumovio, SciEngineer)

name: HackYeah
description: Europe's biggest stationary hackathon: 24 hours of coding at Tauron Arena Krakow across Defence, Smart City, Sport & Healthcare and AI tracks, plus a dedicated SheHacks challenge.

name: Web3 Warsaw Hackathon
description: Hackathon track of Web3 Warsaw / Blockchain Week Warsaw, where developers build and compete on real-world Web3 challenges alongside a 5000+ attendee blockchain conference.

name: GrowUp Hackathon
description: Free month-long online program where 15 teams of young adults build solutions to mental health, loneliness, climate and adulting challenges, ending with a Krakow grand finale.

name: EUDIS Defence Hackathon (Krakow)
description: Local Polish node of the EU-wide EUDIS Defence Hackathon, where teams built counter-drone and cognitive-warfare solutions at the Krakow Technology Park.

name: Kosciuszkon
description: 24-hour academic hackathon at Krakow University of Technology with cybersecurity challenge tracks (including CTF and FPGA) set with partner Honeywell.

name: CASSINI Hackathon (Wroclaw)
description: 11th edition of the EU's CASSINI space-tech hackathon, 'Space for Water': teams used Copernicus and Galileo satellite data to tackle water scarcity, flooding and pollution.
venue_name: Wroclaw University of Science and Technology
prizes: Mentoring support and presentation at Made in Wroclaw conference

name: European Defense Tech Hackathon - Warsaw
description: Dual-use and defence-tech hackathon bringing 100+ hackers to Warsaw with support from the Polish Development Fund (PFR) for a weekend of building and a Sunday demo day.

name: BITEhack
description: 24-hour academic hackathon organized by BEST AGH Krakow where four-person student teams build a project from scratch across robotics, classical CS and AI tracks.
